source_thread: 2026-07-10 One Time UI, CRM, landing, bot, and launch-priority correction
scope_summary: Register and execute the latest One Time launch priority: beautiful landing, Robot Scheller, visible form-to-CRM lead flow, clickable contact CRM, historical inbox reconciliation, gated immediate class-link follow-up, and launch-ready Rabbi backend UI.
next_action: Codex must run control-tower/current-state reconciliation, preserve the source, create/update the requirement register, then produce and execute the first non-overlapping implementation/code-package wave instead of stopping at another audit.
out_of_scope: public storage of the exact WhatsApp number or credentials
product completion claims based only on audits/prompts/tests
source_statements_covered: The current landing copy and earlier text corrections are not fully implemented.
The landing must be beautiful and production-facing, not review-only or placeholder-looking.
Approved/Drive-derived images should be used where mapped; polished replaceable image slots are acceptable until exact choices are supplied.
The assistant should be named Robot Scheller with subtitle Rabbi Scheller's digital assistant, a face/avatar slot, and WhatsApp affordance.
The public form works and triggers Telegram, but a submitted lead is not visibly findable/openable in CRM.
CRM contacts are displayed sloppily, tags overwhelm the cards, and each contact needs a real detail page/workbench.
Email and WhatsApp history should appear on the contact record.
The historical upload of roughly 2,600 emails is not visibly present in the complete Rabbi/Super Admin inbox.
The business WhatsApp bot number supplied privately, ending 8614, should capture inbound leads and put them into CRM.
New interested families should promptly receive the current free-class/Zoom link by approved WhatsApp, email, or both.
The class is currently free until Rosh Hashanah, using Israel-time campaign configuration.
Rabbi-facing UI must not expose irrelevant not-scoped/test/review/configured diagnostics, dead controls, unfinished copy, uneven cards, or inconsistent toolbars.
expected_outputs: new raw input and dated requirement register
landing copy source-of-truth and image-slot manifest
acceptance_criteria: Landing is deployed and manually reviewed as a finished campaign at 1440, 1024, 768, 430, and 390 widths.
Robot Scheller identity is exact and does not obstruct conversion controls.
A synthetic/approved form submission can be found and opened in the scoped CRM with source and timeline visible.
Each CRM contact has a coherent detail state with email, WhatsApp, class/trial, notes, and next-action context where available.
The expected historical inbox is either imported and proven or blocked with one exact source/path owner requirement.
Controlled inbound lead follow-up is idempotent, CRM-logged, and gated to the scoped business sender/class-link configuration.
Normal Rabbi UI contains no dead buttons, irrelevant support/setup noise, or unfinished implementation labels.
App-visible Done requires pushed commit, correct deployment, live smoke, before/after screenshots, and manual source-level acceptance.
tests_expected: WAPI inbound idempotency and gated auto-response tests
live One Time smokes and manual visual review
known_blockers: The exact business WhatsApp number must remain runtime/keyholder-only; tracked files may reference only the number ending 8614.
Exact final image choices may remain operator-selectable, but polished slots and already-approved assets must ship now.
Historical email source/path must be located before a complete import can be claimed.
Real class-link sends require scoped provider readiness, exact approved copy, idempotency, and one owner-controlled seed test.
local_state_warning: GitHub-connected ChatGPT sees committed/pushed GitHub state only. Codex must refresh CONTROL-TOWER.md and current worktree/agent lanes before editing shared files.
